title: Prime Minister shares an article on how India's fight against poverty is changing lives across the country
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, today, shared an article by Union Minister Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman on how India's fight against poverty is changing lives across the country. Union Finance Minister Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman writes about how PM Shri Narendra Modi's leadership has shifted the focus from temporary relief to addressing the barriers that perpetuate poverty. "Through access to housing, healthcare, clean water, banking and entrepreneurship, she traces the progress made by crores of households and the growing economic participation of rural women", Shri Modi remarked. Shri Modi posted on X; From necessities to new livelihood opportunities, India's fight against poverty is changing lives across the country!
